lines.en: My six legs cross over the sand

lines.zh: 我的甲壳一节一节起伏
lines.en: My shell plates rise and fall in sequence

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上斜着走下来
lines.en: I come down the dune at an angle

lines.zh: 我踩出的坑很快就平了
lines.en: The pits I leave fill in quickly
My forelimbs are held above the sand

lines.zh: 我在沙面上留下一道浅痕
lines.en: I leave a faint track across the sand
I circle half way around a stone

lines.zh: 我的身体比看上去要低
lines.en: My body rides lower than it looks
I head for another dune

lines.zh: 我从沙丘的背风面往上爬
lines.en: I climb the leeward face of the dune

lines.zh: 我的节肢在沙里一深一浅
lines.en: My joints sink deep and shallow in the sand

lines.zh: 我一边走一边转头看四周
lines.en: I turn my head to scan as I walk

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙上晃动得很快
lines.en: My shadow flickers quickly over the sand

lines.zh: 我从一丛枯草旁边经过
lines.en: I pass a clump of dry grass

lines.zh: 我朝太阳相反的方向走
lines.en: I walk away from the sun

lines.zh: 我踩实一步再抬另一条腿
lines.en: I plant one step and lift another
I lie still on the sand
My color matches the sand
My mouthparts open and close gently

lines.zh: 我在听沙子滑落的声音
lines.en: I listen to sand sliding

lines.zh: 我一动不动地看着前方
lines.en: I watch the front without moving

lines.zh: 我的甲壳把阳光反射出去
lines.en: My shell throws the sunlight back
I wait for something to pass
I half bury my body in the sand
My antennae sweep the air
I listen to sounds under the sand
My joints are drawn in tight

lines.zh: 我在晒太阳，晒得甲壳发暖
lines.en: I am sunning, my shell warming

lines.zh: 这一片沙漠现在是虫群的
lines.en: This desert now belongs to the swarm

lines.zh: 我比你矮，但我有六条腿
lines.en: I am shorter than you, but I have six legs
What are you doing here
My forelimbs lifted a little
Do you mean to cross this sand
I am looking at the length of your shadow

lines.zh: 你站着的时候影子很长
lines.en: Your shadow is long while you stand

lines.zh: 我看着你的脚，不看你的脸
lines.en: I watch your feet, not your face
One joint of my leg is bent
What leaks from me is green
My legs can still walk

lines.zh: 我的甲壳上多了一个白点
lines.en: A white spot appeared on my shell
My mouthparts will not close
I fall back half a block and stop
My legs are not quite obeying
I sink my body into the sand
This is not my food

lines.zh: 你手上没有沙漠的味道
lines.en: Your hands carry no desert smell

lines.zh: 虫群吃的东西和你不一样
lines.en: The swarm eats differently from you
Holding it up does nothing

lines.zh: 我只需要沙子下面的东西
lines.en: I need only what lies under the sand
There is nothing like this in the desert

lines.zh: 我从来没见过这种味道
lines.en: I have never smelled this before
Holding it makes me want you more
This one is hard to bite
You cracked an arachnid joint underfoot.
My shell clacked against your boot

lines.zh: 我退了半步，把前肢护住
lines.en: I back half a step and shield my forelimbs
We knocked sand into the air
This bump does not count as a fight
You kicked my side plate
My shell did not dent
I slipped away without a sound
The swarm does not work that way
My place is in the middle of the column
These things are decided by the nest
I turn my head toward the dunes
I live by the swarm's rules
The nest arranges such things
I am only one of the column
I fold my forelimbs in
I lower my head to the sand

lines.zh: 我的前肢并在一起，没有别的动作
lines.en: I put my forelimbs together, and nothing more
I pinch it with my forelimbs
This can go back to the nest
I push it under the sand
I pick up what falls too
This piece is too light

lines.zh: 我用前肢夹住再送到口器边
lines.en: I pinch it and pass it to my mouthparts
This piece is too hard

lines.zh: 沙里那点黏液，是我的口粮。
lines.en: That slime in the sand is my ration.
There are vibrations on the sand

lines.zh: 沙漠的虫群，黏液球是我们的。
lines.en: In the desert swarm, slime balls are ours.
My forelimbs are already spread
I turn that way
The sand keeps trembling
My shadow turns toward it
I have noted its position
I begin to approach at an angle
I am ready to come under the sand

lines.zh: 我把重心往前挪了一点
lines.en: I shift my weight forward a little

lines.zh: 我不急躁，我有的是时间
lines.en: I am not rushed, I have plenty of time

lines.zh: 沙在震，我的六条腿同时压下去。
lines.en: The sand shakes as all six of my legs press down at once.

lines.zh: 它没注意到沙下的动静
lines.en: It has not noticed the movement under the sand
I keep low against the sand
Its steps make the grains jump
I follow the vibration
I am two blocks at its flank and rear
I wait for it to stop on the sand
My mouthparts are already open

lines.zh: 它的影子和我的影子叠在一起
lines.en: Its shadow overlaps mine
One more block and I move

lines.zh: 我的甲壳贴着沙面滑过去
lines.en: My shell slides along the sand surface
I clamp it with my forelimbs
My mouthparts bite down
I bump once and withdraw
This carries my weight
I burst up from under the sand
My forelimbs clamp its leg

lines.zh: 我的口器咬在它的脚背
lines.en: My mouthparts bite its instep
I shove it and fall back half a block
My joints kick up a spray of sand
I clamp and let go at once
I bore up out of the dune

lines.zh: 我的甲壳上还挂着沙粒
lines.en: Sand still clings to my shell

lines.zh: 虫群已经控制了这片沙漠
lines.en: The swarm already holds this desert
I bring several of my kind at once

lines.zh: 我从沙里出来，甲壳上是新的沙
lines.en: I come out of the sand, fresh grains on my shell
The swarm sent me to scout this area

lines.zh: 我一次和几个同类一起出现
lines.en: I appear with several of my kind at once
The sand here is too fine
First I head for the dunes

lines.zh: 火把我的甲壳烤得发烫
lines.en: Fire made my shell burn hot
I rolled down from the top of the dune

lines.zh: 沙子下面的水把我困住了
lines.en: The water under the sand trapped me

lines.zh: 爆炸把沙子和我一起掀起来
lines.en: The blast threw sand and me into the air

lines.zh: 一颗弹丸打穿了我的甲
lines.en: A shot pierced my shell

lines.zh: 那股术力在我的节肢间穿
lines.en: That magic threaded between my joints

lines.zh: 我还没找到能吃的东西
lines.en: I have not found anything to eat
Lightning struck the sand and it turned to glass
The sand under me is gone
